meta.name: agent-designer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to design a multi-agent system, pick an orchestration pattern (supervisor/swarm/pipeline), generate tool schemas for agents, or evaluate agent execution logs for cost, latency, and failure bottlenecks. Examples: 'design an agent architecture for research automation', 'generate Anthropic tool schemas from these tool descriptions', 'analyze these agent run logs for bottlenecks'. NOT for Claude Code workflow files (use workflow-builder) or single-agent prompt design (use agent-workflow-designer).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计多智能体系统架构并分析运行日志
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计或优化多智能体协作系统
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-agent system architectures and analyze execution logs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or optimize multi-agent collaboration systems

howto.what: Claude 会调用配套脚本按流程设计多智能体系统：先根据需求规划架构并生成 Mermaid 图，再为智能体生成工具 schema，最后评估执行日志找出成本、延迟和故障瓶颈，并给出优化建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计多智能体系统、选择编排模式（如 supervisor、swarm、pipeline）、生成工具 schema，或分析执行日志中的瓶颈时触发。

say.text: 按我的需求设计一个四智能体的调研自动化系统
say.note: 会运行 planner 生成架构图和实现路线图。

say.text: 把这些工具描述生成 Anthropic 格式的 schema
say.note: 会运行 schema 生成器并校验每个工具。

say.text: 分析这份执行日志的延迟和失败瓶颈
say.note: 会运行 evaluator 输出详细评估报告。

howto.what_en: Claude will drive bundled scripts to design multi-agent systems: plan architecture from requirements (outputs Mermaid diagram), generate validated tool schemas for agents, and evaluate execution logs for cost, latency, and failure bottlenecks with recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to design a multi-agent system, choose an orchestration pattern (e.g., supervisor, swarm, pipeline), generate tool schemas, or analyze execution logs for bottlenecks.

say_en.text: Design a four-agent research automation system from my requirements.
say_en.note: Runs the planner to output architecture and Mermaid diagram.

say_en.text: Generate Anthropic-format schemas from these tool descriptions.
Analyze this execution log for latency and failure bottlenecks.
say_en.note: Runs the evaluator for a detailed report.
